settings.heading: Print this, and measure a ring you already wear
settings.intro: Every band is resized free for life, up to three sizes either way. This sheet is here so the first one usually is not needed.
settings.warning: Print at 100%. In the print dialog set scale to 100% or Actual size — Fit to page will shrink the sheet and every circle with it. On screen this page is not to scale.
settings.footnote: Sizes are inner circumference in millimetres, which is what Brazilian and European sizing measure. If you are between two, take the larger and tell us — we set it to the finger, not to the table.

settings.heading: What if I get it wrong?
settings.text: Resizing is free for life, up to three sizes either way. Write to us and we send a prepaid insured label.

settings.heading: Does the width of the band change the size?
settings.text: Yes. A band wider than about 6mm usually needs half a size more. Tell us the piece and we allow for it.

settings.heading: When should I measure?
settings.text: At the end of the day, at room temperature. Fingers are smallest in the cold morning and largest after heat or salt.

settings.heading: Can an engraved ring be resized?
settings.text: One size at most before the engraving distorts. This is why engraved pieces are final sale, and we say it before you order.
